## Now to 9 December: gather quietly, file nothing new

I obtain certified copies in my own name: the notarial registers, the DENR plan file, the Registry's Primary Entry Book, Spec. Proc. 2156, and, through Mrs. King, the Civil Case 8563 record. Nothing is filed in court. These records were not pre-marked, so in our case-in-chief they would need leave; held for rebuttal, each answers a claim their witnesses will have sworn. The subpoena request is reworked for rebuttal and filed after the defense rests. The strategy is in Annex A.

**No discovery motions.** A request for admission and a motion for production after trial has begun are uncommon here and could be refused as late. The same facts go to their own witnesses on cross, each with its document (the cross-examination checklist). Both drafts are held in reserve if you prefer to file them.

I will obtain by 20 October the complete certified Exhibits E and H.
